[[File:SerpJester-SW1977-64.jpg|thumb|right|upright|A Serp jester]]
A '''jester''' was a type of performer who specialized in comedy and juggling. Jesters frequently wore outlandish costumes while performing. The [[Alanciari]], [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] inhabitants of the continent [[Alanciar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], used jesters in their decennial [[Observance Day]] celebrations. The [[Serp]]s of the planet [[Serphidi/Legends|Serphidi]] employed jesters in the [[Castle S'Shah|castle]] of the [[King/Legends|King]]. The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] also had jesters composed of those of low class, a notable example being [[Onimi]], who was secretly the mastermind behind the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|Yuuzhan Vong Invasion]]. A similar occupation to a jester is a [[Clown/Legends|clown]].
